### Important Changes - **feat(nextjs): Add `@sentry/nextjs/cloudflare` ([#24998](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/24998))** The new `@sentry/nextjs/cloudflare` entry point exports `withSentry` for the Worker entry of a Next.js app on Cloudflare Workers, for example `.open-next/worker.js` of OpenNext. It is `withSentry` of `@sentry/cloudflare` with the Next.js server handling added, so a Next.js app on Workers gets the same spans as on Node.js. ```ts import * as Sentry from '@sentry/nextjs/cloudflare'; import handler from './.open-next/worker.js'; export default Sentry.withSentry( env => ({ dsn: env.SENTRY_DSN, tracesSampleRate: 1.0, }), handler, ); ``` - **feat(server-utils): Add instrumentation for pi-durable ([#24993](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/24993))** The new `piDurableIntegration` traces agents built with [pi-durable](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/tree/main/packages/durable): each run, with its model requests and tool calls. - **fix(core): Correct sleep clock drift on telemetry timestamps ([#23054](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/23054))** When a device sleeps, the `performance.now()` clock of the browser stops. Before this change, timestamps of spans and other telemetry recorded after the sleep could be too early. The SDK now detects this drift and corrects its time origin, also for spans created from performance entries. Span end times are now computed from the `performance.now()` duration since the span start, like in OpenTelemetry ([#24903](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/24903)). ### Other Changes - feat(cloudflare): Skip spans for the pi_ tables of PiHarness ([#25028](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/25028)) - feat(remix): Propagate the server trace to Remix 3 page loads ([#25145](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/25145)) - feat(server-utils): Map Mastra classifier evaluations to gen_ai.evaluate spans ([#25044](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/25044)) - feat(server-utils): Record LangChain TypeSafeClassifier runs as gen_ai.evaluate spans ([#25120](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/25120)) - fix(browser): Check for clock drift on page lifecycle events ([#25091](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/25091)) - fix(core): Exclude attachments from internal exception events ([#25160](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/25160)) - fix(effect): Convert Effect span times to the Sentry clock ([#24972](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/24972)) - fix(effect): Detect HTTP spans named after the request method ([#25159](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/25159)) - fix(node): Register Vercel keep-alive listeners once ([#25146](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/25146)) - fix(replay): Place CLS and INP web vitals at the right time ([#24990](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/24990)) - fix(server-utils): Record LangGraph span I/O for non-MessagesAnnotation state ([#23315](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/23315)) - fix(sveltekit): Upload source maps with SvelteKit 3 ([#25139](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/pull/25139))
